entities.summary: Muzaffar al-Din Jahan Shah ibn Yusuf, also known as Abu al-Muzaffar Jahan Shah or Jihan Shah, was the leader of the Qara Qoyunlu tribal confederacy from 1438 to 1467. Jahan Shah wrote lyrical poems in Azerbaijani Turkic under the pen name Haqiqi.
